paragraphs: Mentioned in Tanchuma, Noach 8. Hyman says that the statement also appears there in Emor 17, where the name is R' Yehudah bar Ami; note 66 gives R' Yehudah Beribbi or bar Chiya.[^1][^2]

notes.text: Beribbi is retained as a name or designation without imposing a new father-son relation. The annotated edition is not specified.

The checked Buber Tanchuma Noach 8 paragraph names Yehudah bar Chama. The intended bar Ami wording and note 66 were not matched in the complete checked Buber Emor 17 and standard Emor 17 paragraphs. The edition behind Hyman’s annotation remains unspecified; this bounded nonmatch does not prove absence. Beribbi remains a designation without an imposed father relation. R’ preserves the supplied abbreviated title where a full title for the particular reported form has not been established.
